    <content type="html"><h2><a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/compare/0.122.0...0.122.1">0.122.1</a> (2026-08-26)</h2>
<h3>Features</h3>

<li><strong>providers:</strong> add Gemini 3.7 Flash and Flash-Lite (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10389" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10389/hovercard">#10389</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/bc6b189ba7a2f21098a2e52c9f46063c62a6f696">bc6b189</a>)</li>
<li><strong>redteam:</strong> account for multi-turn attacker and grading tokens (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10407" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10407/hovercard">#10407</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/33cc8bc90e07d6c4ba36c83001cca1b4726b7593">33cc8bc</a>)</li>
<li><strong>redteam:</strong> report generation, target, attacker, and grading tokens (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10408" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10408/hovercard">#10408</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/0891e4e9e49d1c63df6379b1dfbb79bac659e331">0891e4e</a>)</li>
<li><strong>tracing:</strong> add test-case roots and universal target spans (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10328" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10328/hovercard">#10328</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/334586ee4b21e56d16cff63c9b82134614d05486">334586e</a>)</li>
